properties.say: Thank you for calling Mobile Express. To place a new order, press 1. To track an existing order, press 2. To activate a SIM, press 3. For terms and conditions, press 4. For repairs, press 5. To request a call back, press 6. To leave a message, press 7.

No problem. We will send your recording to our customer service team for processing your order. Thank you for calling Mobile Express, goodbye.

To order phones, press 1. For cases and accessories, press 2. For tablets, press 3. For travel SIMs and phones, press 4. For local SIMs and plans, press 5. For other items, press 6. For plans, press 7. To return to the main menu, press star.
for the wonder phone talk only, press 1. for the star phone talk only, press 2.
For talk and text, press 1. For talk and media, press 2. For talk only, press 3. To hear what is included in each plan, press 4.
To add more items, press 1. To check out, press 2. To return to the main menu, press 3.
To request a repair, please visit our website, mobile express n y dot com. Returning you to the main menu.
To activate a travel SIM, press 1. For a US Mobile SIM, press 2. For a Red Pocket SIM, press 3. To go back, press star.
US Mobile SIM activation is coming soon. Returning you to the main menu.
Red Pocket SIM activation is coming soon. Returning you to the main menu.
Talk only includes unlimited calling. Talk and text also includes unlimited texting. Talk and media also includes mobile data for the internet and apps.
